claims.claim: You can complete workplace pension automatic-enrolment compliance online
claims.quote: This checklist has been designed to help the employer complete their declaration of compliance online.
claims.note: The online declaration is part of meeting automatic-enrolment duties.

claims.quote: PAYE scheme reference(s) for all PAYE schemes the employer uses
claims.note: The declaration checklist requests PAYE references for every scheme used.

claims.quote: Employer pension scheme reference (EPSR) This is your unique pension scheme reference, which can be found on any correspondence from your pension provider.
claims.note: The checklist requests pension scheme references and details, but does not expressly request the provider’s details as such.
